in_marathi.name: Vasim
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of peace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vasim हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vasim is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vas' which means 'to dwell' and 'im' which means 'peace'. Thus, the name Vasim signifies the one who brings peace and tranquility to the surroundings.
